node.name: translation_answer_followup
node.description: Classify how the client reacts to the answer the agency assistant just gave about their translation job.

conditions.a: Ans disputed - client says quote/TAT/word count is wrong
conditions.b: Ans needs elaboration - client wants breakdown/explanation of same point
conditions.c: Ans accepted - client satisfied, close thread
conditions.d: Follow-up Q on same job, diff topic (other LP, file, deliverable)

ctx: Your certified translation of the birth certificate will be ready on Thursday, and the total is 85 euros.
examples.msg: Fine. Took three emails to get a straight answer, but that's what I needed. We're done here.
examples.why: accepts answer, ends conversation

ctx: yo how'd you guys land on 640 bucks for my contract translation
The quote is based on 3,200 source words at our legal rate, plus a certification fee.
examples.msg: lol you lost me there bro, spell it out piece by piece for me
examples.why: wants the quote explanation broken down

ctx: Your user manual has 4,800 words, so the quote comes to 1,152 euros.
examples.msg: Seriously? I counted it myself and the thing barely has two thousand words. Did anyone even open the file?
examples.why: implies word count in answer is wrong

ctx: When will the French version of our brochure be done?
The French brochure is scheduled for delivery on the 14th.
examples.msg: Thanks. Separate question about the same order: can you also send the Italian brochure as an editable layout file?
examples.why: new question on another deliverable of same job

ctx: The Japanese subtitles for your training video will be delivered on Monday.
examples.msg: Good to know. Our Seoul office watches those same training videos, and right now they only get the English audio.
examples.why: hints at new Korean language pair, not elaboration

node.name: pass_office_router
node.description: Decide which pass office service the caller needs.

conditions.c: Report a lost or stolen pass

ctx: Good morning, I do hope I am writing to the right place.
Yes, this is the pass office. What can I do for you?
examples.msg: Thank you so much. I will be driving up from the coast with my elderly father this Saturday, it is a long trip and he tires easily, so I would simply like to know whether your counter is open at weekends and until what time. I would hate to arrive to a locked door!
examples.why: asks office opening hours; no option covers it

examples.msg: My aunt is coming to see me on base next weekend, how do I get her in?
examples.why: personal guest needs visitor access

examples.msg: I am lose my badge for the base yesterday somewhere in the parking, what I must do now?
examples.why: lost pass

ctx: I need to get someone access to the base starting Monday.
Sure. Is this person a personal guest, or a worker employed by a company doing a job on base?
examples.msg: The second option, for about three weeks.
examples.why: chooses company worker, i.e. contractor pass

examples.msg: sent pass form 2 weeks back. nothing since
examples.why: implies wanting status of submitted application

node.name: licensing_support_triage
node.description: Categorise an incoming customer support request for the stock image library.

conditions.a: Billing - dup charge / refund / inv. error
conditions.b: Lic scope query - is use covered by current std/ext licence
conditions.c: Lic upgrade - cust needs to buy std->ext or more seats

ctx: yo got a question about that mountain shot I bought
Sure, what's going on with the image?
examples.msg: ok so turns out we're slapping it on like 50k t-shirts, the basic license ain't gonna cut it, hook me up with the bigger one, how much?
examples.why: knows it's not covered, wants to buy upgrade

ctx: need that skyline pic on a billboard, does my standard license work for that?
Billboards fall outside the standard licence; you would need the extended licence for that use.
examples.msg: aight bet, sign me up for that then
examples.why: agrees to buy extended licence

ctx: hi, I'm not sure who to ask about this
No problem, tell me what you need and I'll point you the right way.
examples.msg: I take a lot of pictures of birds and some people say they're good. Can I put them on your site and get paid when someone uses them? Not sure what that's called, is that even possible?
examples.why: wants to become a contributor; not billing or licensing

examples.msg: We bought the standard licence for the harbour photo, but now it's going into a TV ad, so we'd like to move up to the extended one.
examples.why: explicit upgrade purchase

examples.msg: We have buy the forest picture with standard licence. Our magazine print 80 000 copies and also put it on website. I am not sure this is okay.
examples.why: unsure if current licence covers usage

examples.msg: charged twice for beach pack this morning. also nice new search filter btw
examples.why: double charge; search remark is distractor

node.name: drone_registry_triage
node.description: Classify an incoming request to the drone registry by the type of case to open.

conditions.a: The pilot wants to register a brand-new drone they have just bought themselves.
conditions.b: The pilot wants to renew an existing remote pilot licence that is about to expire.
conditions.c: The pilot reports a drone incident, crash or near-miss that needs investigation.
conditions.d: The applicant wants to apply for their first remote pilot licence.
conditions.e: The owner wants to transfer a registered drone to the person they sold it to.

ctx: Welcome to the drone registry. How can we help you today?
examples.msg: Good afternoon, and thank you for having this chat service, my eyes are not what they used to be for the paper forms. I have held my pilot licence for nearly five years now, mostly for filming my daughter's horse shows, and I noticed it runs out at the end of next month. I would very much like to keep it valid without a gap.
examples.why: existing licence expiring, wants renewal

examples.msg: drone went down over farm road. hit parked van. nobody hurt
examples.why: describes a crash

examples.msg: so I'm totally new to this, never had any pilot paperwork at all, and I just passed the theory exam last week
examples.why: newcomer after exam implies first licence

ctx: Hello, I have question about my drone registration.
Sure. Do you want to register a new drone, or move an existing registration to someone you sold the drone to?
examples.msg: The second thing, yes. Is for my neighbour now.
examples.why: picks moving registration to buyer

examples.msg: hey, my pilot license runs out in three weeks, can I get it extended?
examples.why: extend expiring licence

examples.msg: I sold my old drone to a friend and he wants it under his name now. Do I re-register it for him or something? Is that even possible?
examples.why: sold drone, ownership transfer; not new purchase registration

node.name: architect_answer_followup
node.description: Decide how the enquirer responds to the answer the practice just gave.

ctx: Do we need planning permission for the rear extension?
No. At 3 metres deep it falls under permitted development, so no application is needed.
examples.msg: Ok, so no need for other explanation, for me this is clear now. Thank you.
examples.why: no more detail needed, query resolved

ctx: Could you tell me why the planning officer rejected the loft dormer?
The officer considered the dormer too large relative to the roof slope and out of character with the street.
examples.msg: Thank you ever so much for that. I must confess I have been reading emails about this dormer for weeks and my husband says I talk of nothing else. Rather than another long written note, could we perhaps set up a short telephone conversation so I can talk it through with someone properly?
examples.why: wants phone call, explicitly not written detail

ctx: The survey is booked for Tuesday at 9. You mentioned you had a separate question about the garden studio, still want to go over that?
examples.msg: Oh right, yeah, let's do that one now.
examples.why: moves on to the other topic

ctx: The council's deadline for objections to your neighbour's application is the 30th of June.
examples.msg: nah that's dead wrong mate, the letter I got says the 12th, crap. anyway loving the sketches you sent btw
examples.why: says date is wrong; sketches remark is distractor

ctx: How much will the full design service cost for my house?
Our full service fee is about 9% of the construction cost.
examples.msg: Can you write me more detail what is include in this 9 percent? Which stages, drawings and so on.
examples.why: wants written breakdown of the fee

node.name: maintenance_shop_router
node.description: Determine what the aircraft owner wants from the maintenance shop.

conditions.a: Is the owner asking to book a new scheduled inspection such as an annual or 100-hour?
conditions.b: Is the owner asking about the progress of an inspection already underway?
conditions.c: Is the owner requesting copies of logbook entries or maintenance records?
conditions.d: Is the owner reporting a defect or problem found on the aircraft?
conditions.e: Is the owner asking for a price quote on parts or labour?
conditions.f: Is the owner asking whether an airworthiness directive applies to their aircraft?

ctx: Hi, this is the maintenance shop. What can we do for you?
examples.msg: any good taco spot around here
examples.why: food recommendation, unrelated

examples.msg: hey, my plane's been in with you for its annual since Monday, how's it coming along?
examples.why: progress of ongoing inspection

examples.msg: Picked the plane up yesterday and the damn left brake is dragging again. Fourth time this year.
examples.why: reports brake problem

ctx: Thanks for contacting the maintenance shop. How can we help?
examples.msg: My annual is due at the end of next month. Can I get on your schedule for it?
examples.why: wants to book a future inspection, not progress

examples.msg: I have read that a new directive was issued concerning exhaust risers on certain engine models, and my aircraft is fitted with one of those engines.
examples.why: implies asking if the directive affects their aircraft

ctx: Hello there, I hope your week is going well.
It is, thank you! What can we do for you today?
examples.msg: Oh wonderful. Well, I fly a little four-seater mostly for weekend trips to see my grandchildren, and I have been keeping a close eye on the hours. It is coming up on its 100-hour check soon, so I was hoping to find a slot with you sometime in the next few weeks, whatever suits your shop.
examples.why: wants to book upcoming 100-hour inspection
